crossRefs.note: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you…
Only fear Yahweh, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied…

parallels.note: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

translations.web: that they may fear you, to walk in your ways, so long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.
translations.bsb: so that they may fear You and walk in Your ways all the days they live in the land that You gave to our fathers.
translations.kjv: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
translations.asv: that they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
